"""Brute force warmup: simulate the schedule implied by the certificate."""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, topo, algo


def step_info(F, guard, prev, kind, phase):
    """(delta, bound contribution) of the step into `phase` from `prev`."""
    pp, pi = divmod(prev, F.N)
    if kind == -1:
        return 1, F.rate[pp][pi]*F.T
    lid = kind//2; dr = kind%2
    link = F.links[lid]
    if dr == 0:
        src=link['ends'][0][0]; dst=link['ends'][1][0]; delay=link['delay_ns'][0]; defer=link['defer_rounds'][0]
    else:
        src=link['ends'][1][0]; dst=link['ends'][0][0]; delay=link['delay_ns'][1]; defer=link['defer_rounds'][1]
    rho=F.rho[pp]
    x1=rho+delay; delta=(x1+F.T-1)//F.T+defer
    cost=F.allow_by_code[kind]+F.ageing(pp,dst,x1,delta)
    return delta, cost


def brute_warmup(F, guard, preds, bounds, ages):
    """First cycle in which every phase-device attains its minimal bound."""
    P,N = F.P, F.N
    def value(t, v, memo):
        """(bound, age) known at boundary t for state v, or None."""
        key=(t,v)
        if key in memo: return memo[key]
        p,i = divmod(v,N)
        cell = preds[p][i]
        if cell is None:
            res = (0,0) if i in F.anchor_nodes[p] else None
            memo[key]=res
            return res
        prev, kind = cell
        delta, cost = step_info(F, guard, prev, kind, p)
        base = value(t-delta, prev, memo)
        if base is None:
            res=None
        else:
            res=(base[0]+cost, base[1]+delta)
        memo[key]=res
        return res
    cycle=0
    limit = 40
    for k in range(limit):
        ok=True
        memo={}
        for t in range(k*P, k*P+P):
            for i in range(N):
                v=(t%P)*N+i
                got=value(t,v,memo)
                if got is None or got[0]!=bounds[t%P][i] or got[1]!=ages[t%P][i]:
                    ok=False; break
            if not ok: break
        if ok: return k
    return None
PYEOF
